stream_pool_parallel_processing: process items from an iterator in parallel using thread or process executors with configurable max workers
stream_pool_exception_handling: handle exceptions during parallel processing by yielding error tuples alongside successful results from the stream
stream_pool_timeout_handling: set a timeout for each task in the stream pool executor to handle slow or hanging tasks
sequential_executor_submit: submit and execute tasks sequentially using the SequentialExecutor with optional timeout support for synchronous processing
terminable_process_pool_executor_termina: terminate long-running subprocesses by submitting tasks to TerminableProcessPoolExecutor and calling terminate on the future
